# SeamlessFlow.ai

> Brand growth agency based in New York City. We make content that brings in customers: a discovery call and full brand audit, then a monthly cycle of content planning, scripts, shoot days, editing, posting on Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and YouTube, analytics, and paid ads on the videos that already perform. We travel for clients.

## How it works
- Once, at the start: discovery call, full brand audit (Google Business Profile, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, website), brand roadmap.
- Every month: content plan, scripts and shot list, shoot day, editing, posting, analytics, ads on proven content.
- Results in as little as 30, 15, or 7 days depending on the package. "Results" means first videos live and real numbers coming in.

## Packages (monthly, starting at)
- Launch: from $3,000/mo. 8 videos, half-day shoot, posting on 4 platforms, boosts on top videos, monthly report.
- Growth: from $4,500/mo. 12 videos, full-day shoot, comment and DM replies using approved answers, ad campaigns on top videos, report every two weeks.
- Full Service: from $6,500/mo. 20+ videos, two shoot days, ads on Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and YouTube, Google SEO and Business Profile, auto-replies, weekly report and strategy call.
- Final price is set after the audit based on market, locations, and shoot volume. One-time onboarding fee set by the audit. Ad spend is paid directly to the platforms.

## Add-ons
Google SEO, Google Business Profile, lead follow-up automation, AI chat assistant, website builds, security audits.

## Industries
Roofing, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, remodeling and contractors, junk removal, moving, landscaping. Open to any business ready to grow.
